identification: Four glass pieces, no maker marks visible: (1) white-bodied glass fish with multicolour confetti/speckle (brown, amber, red, pink) and clear applied fins, Murano-style 'fiori' fish, c.1960s-70s, about 25-30cm; (2) orange free-form 'tulip' / five-lobed art glass vase with clear base, Murano-style or Scandinavian/American (Viking-type) mid-century, unmarked in photos; (3) amberina diamond-point pressed glass footed jug/creamer with applied yellow handle (Jeannette or Indiana-style, 1950s); (4) clear and orange fluted/ribbed small vase or tumbler with trapped bubble texture (maker unknown). Armitage estimate 60-80, current bid $20, AS IS.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 60-80, current bid $20 (+22% premium). No marks seen on any piece. Check the base of the orange tulip vase and the fish for a Murano/Venini/Viking label or signature, the fish fins for chips, and the hobnail jug for rim chips. Carter's says Venetian/Murano fish median A$169 (84 results), but that is dominated by signed or larger pieces; the common unmarked 'Murano style' fish sells A$28-77 on eBay. Rough resale if sold separately: fish about A$45-75, orange vase about A$30-60, amberina jug about A$30-55, ribbed vase about A$15-30, so about A$120-220 before fees and postage. Prices 2024-2026 are flat. Fragile and heavy, and each needs a separate listing.
